display.name: Phinix Store Playtest
display.summary: Tests package language files, tab registration, counting and 100 silver. Use test saves.
display.changelog: 1.4.0: migrate to the neutral Compose entry and scoped services; settings and gameplay behavior retained.

strings.intro: This tab checks discovery and registration. The click count is retained through uninstall/reinstall. Silver changes the current save.
strings.silver: Place 100 silver on the current map
strings.confirm: Place 100 silver near this map’s center? This changes the colony and will be retained if you save. Use a test save.
strings.mapRequired: Silver requires a loaded map. Click counting also works without a map.
strings.given: 100 silver placed near the map center. See the Playtest operation log.
strings.failed: Silver placement failed. See the Playtest operation log.
